== Description ==
Purple Reflections II expansion symbol with its printed black rim.

== Source ==
Centered crop from the scan of Decipher's [[Dash Rendar]], [[:File:Ref2-L-dashrendar-hires.webp|file description]] and [[Media:Ref2-L-dashrendar-hires.webp|original scan]], credited to [[Strangewayes]] and the HiRez scanning project. The mark is at the right of the lore box. The crop uses the printed colors, with transparency around the rim.
